description: Q(q)-coefficient leg of the bar-odd element discriminator (#7118 §4a (i)). With F = Q(q+1/q) the bar-fixed field, the solution set of bar(aA+bB) = -(aA+bB) is an F-space of dimension 3 for BOTH Delta_S and Delta_L — over Q(q) the criterion is VACUOUS ((h/A, 0) always works). Restricting to bar-EVEN coefficients (a, b in F, the p<->n-neutral ones): Delta_S admits all of F^2, Delta_L exactly ONE q-dependent F-line (a:b) = (B_e:-A_e). Restricting to Q reproduces #7118 (F^2 vs {0}). The unique normalised bar-odd functional on Delta_L over F is a mixture a tr_q + b tr_{z_D} with ab != 0, and the Markov property at two levels forces ab (q - z_D)^2 = 0, so it is NOT a Markov trace for any z' — Option-G territory; its readout at the proton pin is recorded as a diagnostic, not proposed. Also corrects #7118 §5: Q_BETA_MEV = 0.78233341(61) is sigma-limited, not truncated; the 8.8e-10 is the rounding of the derived m_n literal inside the witness's own float64 reference Q_NEUTRON_MEV. The CODATA-2022 registry gives Q_beta = 0.78233355931(38), +191 ppb (0.3 sigma), which would move c_3 by ~+0.31 through 1/u^3 — a dataset choice put to the owner, not made.
